25. Share premium
On 16th February 2000, a rights issue of one share for every one share held was made at a price of Kshs.21.50
per share. Atotal of 24,000,000 shares were issued.
The net proceeds from the rights issue was Kshs.484.431,000, after deducting issue expenses amounting to
Kshs.31,569,000, hence a share premium arising of Kshs.364,431,000.
